g.aria-label:
Open the saved file in Illustrator / Corel / Inkscape
Try drawing a shape or deleting this text and saving.

Create an object (rectangle, ellipse, closed path, closed path with holes in it) and save.
Open your file explorer, find a video you want to insert and drag it onto the new element in your browser.
Like onto this one:

A page and a slide are the same thing. Since SVG doesn't support multiple pages natively, a page is a rectangle sized the same as the artboard.
Pages are ordered hierarchically. If you create a layer above this and draw a page on it, that page will be third. Note that the pages must not overlap.

The video controls can be customized, they are there
Just keep their names and make sure the progress bar is a rectangle.
